verdict.rationale: Mastra is an AI agent framework with a hosted Studio and enterprise tier, so a data-training privacy posture is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence addresses training on user data: there is no no-training policy, no opt-out control, and no data-usage terms. Self-hosting under Apache 2.0 suggests data can stay in your own infrastructure, but it says nothing about whether Mastra or the model providers it routes to use that data for training.
